# Direction From Angles

Source: [7747](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/7747); edited 2026-01-03. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Direction From Angles](../../api/values/direction-from-angles.md).

<a id="wiki-7747-n1"></a>

- Direction From Angles produces a unit direction using degree angles; page states vertical -90 points down and +90 up.

Source limitations:

- Cross-source sign discrepancy: page states positive vertical angle points up, whereas Vertical Facing Angle Of 4763 increases looking down and Vertical Angle Towards 4762 is positive below. Do not assume interchangeable signs; validate conversion behavior.
